name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A dependency-free month grid with controlled ISO date selection.

files.content:
{{ monthLabel() }}
@for (weekday of weekdays; track weekday) { {{ weekday.slice(0, 2) }} }
@for (week of [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]; track week) {
@for (day of days().slice(week * 7, week * 7 + 7); track day.date) { }
}
